lines.t: Behold the mountains rising high
The rivers carve the earth they sigh
Who can measure skies so wide
Or count the stars that nightly glide
The hands that shaped the galaxies
Hold the breath of you and me
O sons of men
Come see come see
The truth that sets the captive free
The works of man
They fade they fall
But love remains
It conquers all
The sun will set the earth will spin
The waves will crash the tides begin
But deeper still beyond the veil
A love that none can break or fail
The light that split the endless night
Still burns for us still shines so bright
O sons of men
The truth that sets the captive free
The works of man
But love remains
It conquers all
